desc: The ULTRA Scope Mounting Kit from Wheeler® Engineering puts all the best Wheeler scope mounting accessories into one perfect package. With this kit you can level your rifle, level your scope, mount your scope to the rifle and then coarse sight in your scope with precision and accuracy. The ULTRA Scope Mounting Kit even provides thread locker and a lens pen to keep your scope clean and your optics secure on even the largest caliber guns. Includes a lens pen to keep you scope clean and a heavy duty carry case with foam molded compartments for storage.
